{{Quote|I summoned Han to my chamber. As soon as he entered, he gave me a mocking bow and told me that he had come according to my "royal command."|Extract from Leia Organa's journal|<ref name="Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil">''[[Star Wars Journal: Captive to Evil]]''</ref>}}
The '''Senatorial Quarters''' were a series of private chambers established for the [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. These quarters were located within the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], an ancient ziggurat built millennia before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During her stay at the Temple, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] got her own room within the Senatorial Quarters.
